user_03.pt: I don't like my hearing aids, so I designed my own.
user_03.b:
Unfortunately, I'm not able to disclose the manufacturer at this stage.

There are over 430 million people with a disabling hearing loss. 1.3 billion if you include everyone with mild hearing loss, too. It's not quite that rare. There are 3000 people on the waitlist from all age groups. Many people 50+ don't want a product that is positioned for 'old people' and have shown a particular interest in Overtone.

They have hearing aid technology inside, but yes, I think the words "hearing aids" are so negatively connoted that it is better to not use those words if we want to attract first time wearers.

Adjustable, a unique prescription formula, 16 Frequency bands.

As we go into production, more info will become available.

Thanks for the questions!

Have you had hearing aids before? If yes you can describe comparisons, if not just compare to before hearing aids.
